calls the functions at `00343B00` + 0x24, `00343B00` + 0x2F and `00343B00` + 0x39, each with `r9`, passes the second result to `002E9A60`, stores word 0 at `r8+0xA` and clamps the third result to 0..1 (signed: negative gives 0, above 1 gives 1); when the call at `00343B00` + 0x64 with byte `rdx+0x15` returns non-zero it stores byte 0 at `r8+8` and returns, otherwise it stores the `002E9A60` result at dword `r8`, `002E9810(002EB540(that result, byte [rdx+0x15]))` at dword `r8+4`, the first result at dword `r8+0xC`, the clamped value at byte `r8+9` and byte 1 at `r8+8`

passes the result of the call at `00344F00` + 0x18 (with `r9`) to `002E9A60` and stores word 0 at `r8+0xA`; when the call at `00344F00` + 0x30 with byte `rdx+0x15` returns non-zero it stores byte 0 at `r8+8` and returns, otherwise it stores the `002E9A60` result at dword `r8`, `002E9810(002EB540(that result, byte [rdx+0x15]))` at dword `r8+4` and byte 1 at `r8+8`

calls the function at `0034CED0` + 0x10 with `r9` and, when its result is negative (signed), replaces it with the result of the call at `0034CED0` + 0x1B; calls the function at `0034CED0` + 0x25 with `r9` and passes its result to the call at `0034CED0` + 0x2C; then tail-jumps to `00314D40` with the kept value

calls the function at `00352E40` + 0x10 and then the one at `00352E40` + 0x1A, each with `r9`, passes the second result as the first argument and the first result as the second argument to the call at `00352E40` + 0x23, then tail-jumps to `00314D40(1)`

walks the 24-byte records at `022D9AEC` up to `022D9B4C` (four records) and then those at `022D9ABC` up to `022D9AEC` (two records); for each it calls `002DF440` with the sign-extended byte at record `-0xB`, plus 2 when the byte at record `-0xA` is non-zero, then calls `00369800` with dword `+0` and with dword `+4`, storing 0 to each dword after reading it

calls the function at `0050CA40` + 0x13 with `r9` and, when its result is greater than 0 (signed), replaces it with `002E9A60(result)`; stores the value at dword `r8` and, when it is not negative, stores `002EB540(value, byte [rdx+0x15])` at qword `r8+8`
when dword `[r8]` is negative (signed) tail-jumps to `002E3C20(rdx, 0, 0)`; otherwise calls `002EBC90(rdx, 2, 1)` and then `002E3110(rdx, 0, 0, qword [r8+8])` with 0 as the fifth (stack) argument
when dword `[r8]` is negative (signed) tail-jumps to `002E3C20(rdx, 1, 0)`; otherwise calls `002EBC90(rdx, 1, 1)` and then `002E3110(rdx, 1, 0, qword [r8+8])` with 0 as the fifth (stack) argument
